audience: content teams that make voiceover narration and translated audio with Murf AI

useCases.title: Pick a voice for a narration
useCases.text: List the stock voices for one model, with locales and styles. Check your cloned voices too, then choose a voice ID.

useCases.title: Generate a narration file
useCases.text: Convert text to speech with the GEN2 model. The reply gives a URL to the audio file, its length and the characters left. Each call spends credits.

useCases.title: Translate a batch of product lines
useCases.text: Translate a list of texts into one target language. The translations come back in the same order. Each call spends credits.

useCases.title: Check a voice clone that is still processing
useCases.text: Check a voice-cloning job by its request ID. When it completes, the reply gives the new voice ID.

useCases.title: Delete a cloned voice that is no longer used
useCases.text: List the cloned voices, then delete one by its voice ID. The voice can no longer generate speech, and this cannot be undone.
